name: MIKROMB
recent: Mikro MSC 于2026年9月9日签署有条件股份买卖协议，以RM30百万收购Broadguard Sdn Bhd全部股权，代价通过发行51,724,138股新股支付。Bursa Securities已于2026年9月21日批准该等代价股份上市。公司同时出现多项主要职员变动及董事在闭市期内的交易活动。
notable: 代价通过发行51,724,138股新股支付。
Bursa Securities于2026年9月21日批准代价股份的上市及报价。
2026年11月3日，执行董事兼董事经理Yim Yuen Wah在闭市期内以每股RM0.675收购22,200,000股普通股（1.837%）。
risks: 收购代价通过发行51,724,138股新股支付，可能对现有股东股权产生摊薄效应。
董事在闭市期内进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM20.346百万，环比增长15.9%，同比增长3.9%；净利为RM4.905百万，环比增长23.3%，同比增长58.0%；净利率为24.1%，高于上一季度的22.7%。

recent_en: Mikro MSC signed a conditional share sale agreement on 9 September 2026 to acquire 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd for RM30 million, satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares. Bursa Securities approved the listing of the consideration shares on 21 September 2026. The company also saw several principal officer changes and director dealings during the closed period.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Broadguard Sdn Bhd for RM30 million, satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares.
Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of the consideration shares on 21 September 2026.
On 3 November 2026, Executive Director/Managing Director Yim Yuen Wah acquired 22,200,000 ordinary shares (1.837%) at RM0.675 per share during the closed period.
risks_en: The acquisition consideration is satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Directors traded shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.346 million, up 15.9% QoQ and 3.9% YoY; net income was RM4.905 million, up 23.3% QoQ and 58.0% YoY; net margin was 24.1%, higher than 22.7% in the previous quarter.
